Name: Bureau: Shattered Slipper
Overview:
This action packed sequel to Bureau - Agent Kendall, stars a sexy FBI agent with special talents. The visually stimulating crime solving continues with enhanced puzzles and mind-bending clues.

Picking up from the last episode, Agent Kendall has become a rising star in the Bureau. She is confident and bold. The game now offers a new way to solve crimes and an improved smart phone.
